definitions.full: H4997. nod נֹאד ( Judg 4:19 Kt נאוד , i.e. probably נְאוֺד , noun masculine Josh 9:4 skin-bottle, skin (√ unknown; Late Hebrew נוֺד ; Assyrian nâdu , Dl HWB 438 ; Aramaic נוֺדָא ); — ׳נ absolute Psa 119:83 ; construct Judg 4:19 ; 1Sam 16:20 ; suffix נאֹדֶ֑ךָ Psa 56:9 ; plural נאֹדוֺת Josh 9:4 , 13 ; — skin , ׳נ יַיִן 9:4 , 13 ; 1Sam 16:20 ; ׳נ הֶחָלָב Judg 4:19 ; for tears Psa 56:9 (figurative; see Che); ׳נ בְּקִיטוֺר i.e. shrivelled and useless 119:83 (in simile; compare [De] Che Schu De Witt We > as thrust aside, out of the way Now (in Hup), compare De, or as black and wrinkled outwardly, while retaining the choice wine within Bae, after Rosenm Hup). — See Winer RWB. Art. Schlauch Kmp Ri HWB id.
definitions.rootNote: or נאוֹד lemma נֹאוד vowel, corrected to נאוֹד xlit nôʼwd corrected to nʼôwd ; also (feminine) נֹאדָה ; from an unused root of uncertain signification;
